title: Derivations and quasi-derivations of Block Lie superalgebras $S(q)$
summary: We compute the homogeneous derivations and the homogeneous quasi-derivations of the Block Lie superalgebras $S(q)$, whose even part is the Block Lie algebra $\mathcal{B}(q)$. For every $q\in\mathbb C$, the space $\mathfrak{Der}_θ(S(q))$ is the direct sum of the inner derivations and an explicitly given finite-dimensional space of outer derivations; in particular, for $q\neq0$ a new odd outer derivation appears if and only if $q\in2\mathbb Z^*$.
